blocking_unknown: Is the HUD surface's 2D context instrumented by render/text-register.js in the state ui-census.mjs drives, with w > 0 on the toast's run? glyphs.drawText calls ctx.__esNoteText only if the hook exists. Resolved by one browser-minute: raise a toast, call getRenderedText({surface:'hud'}), report entry count and the toast run's w. If absent, acceptance A1 does not exist and everything falls back to A2.
